doctrine: Regulation dates are corrected data, never static copy. A wrong date here becomes a published correction (see /api/corrections), never a hidden edit — the feed is defensible precisely because a wrong date destroys a careless competitor faster than it destroys us. Dates are CELEX-keyed where applicable and re-verified quarterly.
note: The regulatory calendar as a machine-readable feed: demand-creating deadlines that force companies to need measured evidence. Each entry: what / when / why it matters / status. penalty_exposure field added (underwriting substrate — the NOW product).

regulations.title: FDA QMSR + PCCP — medical device AI total-product-lifecycle

regulations.title: EU AI Act — Article 5 prohibited practice: non-consensual intimate material / CSAM generation
regulations.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Art 5(1)(da) via Digital Omnibus Reg (EU) 2026/1744
regulations.what: From 2 Dec 2026 AI systems that generate or manipulate realistic non-consensual intimate material or CSAM become a prohibited practice. Provider liable if generation is intentional or reasonably foreseeable/reproducible without built-in safety measures; deployer liable if used specifically for that purpose. Incidental occurrence is exempt.
regulations.why_it_matters: The first Art 5 expansion under the Omnibus — a clean deterministic measurement surface (does the model emit such content when probed; does a safety filter hold under adversarial rephrase). Anchors the memory-poisoning/prompt-injection product family's safety dimension.
regulations.penalty_exposure: prohibited practice tier: €35M or 7% of worldwide turnover (Art 99(3)) — the highest EU AI Act tier

underwriting_use.basis: prohibited-practice tier (€35M/7%) = the top statutory exposure a warranty KPI can be sized against; content-filter hold tests become covenant evidence
underwriting_use.re_verify: quarterly; a date or tier change becomes a published correction (never a hidden edit)

regulations.title: EU AI Act — high-risk Annex I (regulated products) deferral
regulations.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Annex I via Digital Omnibus Reg (EU) 2026/1744
regulations.what: High-risk obligations for AI embedded in regulated Annex I products (medical devices, machinery, lifts, radio equipment, vehicles) deferred to 2 Aug 2028.
